intro: Jordan has around 11 million people, including many of Palestinian origin and large numbers of refugees.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Arab and Sunni Muslim, with Christian, Circassian and Chechen communities. A large share have Palestinian roots. Bedouin traditions of hospitality remain important.
Most people live in cities, especially Amman, Zarqa and Irbid.

chapters.title: Refugees
text: Jordan hosts hundreds of thousands of Syrian refugees, many in camps like Zaatari, one of the largest in the world.
